fonts.mono: Hasklug Nerd Font (Hasklig), SIL OFL 1.1 (see Hasklug/LICENSE.md)
fonts.acond: Barlow Condensed (Jeremy Tribby), SIL OFL 1.1 (see Barlow/OFL.txt)
fonts.anum: Hasklug Nerd Font (Hasklig), SIL OFL 1.1 (see Hasklug/LICENSE.md)

star: original five-point star drawn by this script (neither font has U+2605)
units: 1x px. offset = glyph quad top-left relative to the pen at the baseline (y down, so negative is above). advance moves the pen.
setting: For each character: if a previous character exists, pen.x += kerning[prev + ch] (absent = 0). Quad at pen + offset, size 'size', UVs 'uv' on page 'page'; then pen.x += advance.
Italic: shear each quad about the baseline, x' = x + (baseline_y - y) * 0.25. The quads stay parallelograms, so the texture maps exactly.
Digits share one advance in every role (tabular), so changing numbers never jitter. The 'tag' role is fully monospaced and has no kerning.
Fit: slots are sized in px. Too wide -> next smaller role of the same face -> truncate with '…'. Never squash.
Ordinals (st/nd/rd/th): numeral in 'display', suffix in 'title', suffix cap top aligned to numeral cap top.

scripts.latin: pages listed per role; a second script adds pages under its own key without moving latin glyphs

format.why: white glyph coverage only; colour comes from vertex/material colour, so 4-bit intensity is enough (16 edge levels)

caption.use: badges, section-divider labels, table footnotes; the smallest size allowed

body.use: descriptions, footer hints, dialog body, breadcrumb, table cells, character names on player panels

row.use: list rows and widget values, stage name plate

title.use: header titles, dialog titles, ordinal suffixes

hero.use: hero tile labels (always set in capitals)

tag.use: name tags and the name-entry field: 4 fixed-width cells, so the caret and the plate never move as letters change

code.use: network codes and addresses (code plate): max 21 characters, 255.255.255.255:65535 = 201.6 px

a_cap14.use: Atlas: plate headings, rail, key glyph letters

a_cap20.use: Atlas: the trail's current screen, dialog titles, stones
